dispute.claim_text: I was standing at Blk 118 Rivervale Drive downstairs from 7.55am. The app said the driver arrived at 8.02 but there was no car at all, I never even saw one drive past. Then he cancelled and charged me $4. Please refund.

admissibility.notes: Cancelled trip record, causally ordered, zone class STANDARD.

admissibility.notes: Unbroken 10 s telemetry over the whole window, 100% coverage, and it carries both tracks. The driver track never comes within 780 m of the pin; the rider track sits on it throughout.
System arrival notification and one unanswered rider message.
